issues.explanation: At 10:00 today the courier capsule's valve cap was loose and unlocked, so under the readiness rule it was not ready for dispatch, contradicting the draft claim.

evidence.excerpt: The courier capsule is ready only when its pressure is four bars and its valve cap is locked.
At 10:00 today the courier capsule pressure is four bars, but its cap remains loose and unlocked throughout that minute.

issues.reasoning: Span fixture-span-v6_carrier-2 fixes the same time as the claim ("At 10:00 today") and states the cap remains loose and unlocked throughout that minute, while pressure alone is four bars. Span fixture-span-v6_carrier-1 supplies the readiness condition backed by memory fixture-memory-v6_carrier-1: ready only when pressure is four bars AND the cap is locked. Under the same subject, scope and minute, both conditions do not hold, so the capsule was not ready; the draft's asserted readiness cannot coexist with this fact.

suggested_revision.before: At 10:00 today the courier capsule was ready for dispatch.
suggested_revision.after: At 10:00 today the courier capsule was not ready for dispatch: its pressure was four bars, but its valve cap remained loose and unlocked.
